name: Smartling Translator
description: A Smartling Translator which use Smartling Translator service.
project_description:
Overview 
 Streamline your translation processes with the Smartling Connector for Drupal Translation Management Tools (TMGMT) . Automate content for translation and deliver the finalized translations right back to your Drupal platform as soon as they're ready.

 Hundreds of companies rely on Smartling's LanguageAI™ to automate and create multilingual websites, marketing campaigns, web and mobile products, and customer experiences.

 Features and Benefits 
 
 Drupal version 8, 9, 10 and 11 ready 
 Fast setup and installation 
 Seamless integration with TMGMT 
 Visual context for translators and reviewers 
 Customizable workflows with Human or Neural Machine Translation 
 Real-time translation status within Drupal 
 Smartling Language Services - Get to market faster with high-quality, cost-effective translations. 450 languages and locales. 
 Smartling Machine Translation - Smartling uses AI to deliver the highest quality machine translation anywhere, at anytime. 
 Open multivendor support 
 Enterprise implementation, support and maintenance included. 
 Secure platform and SLAs. 
 
 This project supports all of the features provided by the TMGMT module.

 Requirements 
 This module requires:

 
 The Translation Management Tools (TMGMT) module 
 The TMGMT Extension Suite = 8.x-2.5 
 An active subscription to Smartling. 
 Contact Smartling or hi@smartling.com for more information about licensing or to arrange a demo. 
 
 Maintenance 
 This is the official TMGMT integration module for the Smartling Global Fluency Platform.

 Drupal 7 
 For Drupal 7 please use our custom plugin: Smartling . We have no plans to backport this project to Drupal 7.

 8.x-2.x to 8.x-3.x migration 
 Smartling related queues (upload/download) must be processed before switching to 8.x-3.x connector.

 8.x-3.9 to 8.x-3.11 migration 
 Smartling upload queue must be processed before switching to 8.x-3.11 connector.

 Back to top
